Paragraphs & Line Breaks

This is a paragraph. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line. Adjacent lines with no blank line between them are joined into the same paragraph. They do not produce a line break.

This is a second paragraph. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.

To force a line break within a paragraph, end a line with two or more spaces
then continue on the next line. That produces a <br>.

Code

Inline Code

Use backticks for inline code. For example: const x = 42; or npm install.

To include a backtick inside inline code, use double backticks: `backtick`.

Fenced Code Blocks

Plain fenced block with no language specified.
// JavaScript
const greet = (name) => {
    return `Hello, ${name}!`;
};

async function fetchData(url) {
    const response = await fetch(url);
    const data = await response.json();
    return data;
}

console.log(greet('PrintMD'));
# Python
def fibonacci(n):
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(2, n + 1):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return b

print([fibonacci(i) for i in range(10)])
-- SQL
SELECT u.id,
       u.name,
       COUNT(p.id)       AS post_count,
       MAX(p.created_at) AS last_post
FROM users u
         LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY post_count DESC
    LIMIT 20;
# Bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

for file in *.md; do
  echo "Processing: $file"
  pandoc "$file" -o "${file%.md}.pdf"
done

// TypeScript
interface Document {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    author?: string;
    createdAt: Date;
    tags: string[];
}

function renderDoc(doc: Document): string {
    return `# ${doc.title}\n\nAuthor: ${doc.author ?? 'Unknown'}`;
}
<?php
// PHP

declare(strict_types=1);

class ArticleRepository
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PDO $db) {}

    public function findPublished(int $limit = 20): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT id, title, slug, published_at
             FROM articles
             WHERE status = :status
             ORDER BY published_at DESC
             LIMIT :limit'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':status' => 'published', ':limit' => $limit]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT * FROM articles WHERE slug = :slug LIMIT 1'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':slug' => $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }
}

// Usage
$repo = new ArticleRepository($pdo);
$articles = $repo->findPublished(limit: 10);

foreach ($articles as $article) {
    echo sprintf("[%s] %s\n", $article['published_at'], $article['title']);
}

Escaping Characters

Use a backslash \ to escape Markdown special characters:

*not italic*

**not bold**

# not a heading

- not a list item

[not a link](https://example.com)

`not code`

Full list of escapable characters: \ ` * _ { } [ ] ( ) # + - . !
